2607.00700.title: LLVM-Bench: Benchmarking and Advancing Large Language Models for LLVM Compiler Issue Resolution
2607.00700.paper_summary: LLVM is a widely used compiler infrastructure whose scale and complexity make issue resolution labor-intensive and challenging. Although large language models (LLMs) have recently achieved remarkable success in issue resolution, their effectiveness on complex system-level LLVM compiler remains largely unexplored. To address this gap, we introduce LLVM-Bench, the first large-scale benchmark for LLVM issue resolution, containing 423 real-world, validated tasks collected from the LLVM project. We further develop LLVM-Gym, a scalable evaluation platform that automates issue reproduction, patch application, compiler building, and test execution. Using LLVM-Bench and LLVM-Gym, we conduct a comprehensive study of four representative LLMs, six retrieval configurations, and three agents. Our results show that current LLM-based issue resolution techniques remain limited on LLVM-Bench, with patch invalidity and build failures as the dominant failure modes. We further reveal a strong complementarity among different LLMs and agents, motivating LLVM-Ens, a lightweight ensemble approach that expands the patch space through integrating the patches generated by diverse techniques, filters incorrect and redundant candidates, and identifies the most promising solution. Our results show that LLVM-Ens achieves a resolution rate of up to 21.99%, further improving LLVM issue resolution.
2607.00700.paper_summary_zh: LLVM 是一個廣泛使用的編譯器基礎架構，其規模和複雜性使得問題解決變得勞動密集且具挑戰性。<lb/>儘管大型語言模型（LLMs）最近在問題解決方面取得了顯著成功，但它們在複雜系統級 LLVM 編譯器上的有效性仍然大多未被探索。<lb/>為了解決這一空白，我們推出了 LLVM-Bench，這是首個針對 LLVM 問題解決的大規模基準，包含了從 LLVM 項目收集的 423 個真實世界的、經過驗證的任務。<lb/>我們進一步開發了 LLVM-Gym，一個可擴展的評估平台，能自動化問題重現、補丁應用、編譯器構建和測試執行。<lb/>利用 LLVM-Bench 和 LLVM-Gym，我們對四個具有代表性的 LLM、六個檢索配置和三個代理進行了全面研究。<lb/>我們的結果顯示，當前基於 LLM 的問題解決技術在 LLVM-Bench 上仍然有限，補丁無效和構建失敗是主要的失敗模式。<lb/>我們進一步揭示了不同 LLM 和代理之間的強互補性，促使我們提出 LLVM-Ens，一種輕量級的集成方法，通過整合各種技術生成的補丁來擴展補丁空間，過濾不正確和冗餘的候選，並識別出最有前景的解決方案。<lb/>我們的結果顯示，LLVM-Ens 的解決率高達 21.99%，進一步改善了 LLVM 的問題解決。
